Title: Some admins may see stale data in the Microsoft 365 Copilot Health page in the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins may see stale data in the Copilot Health page in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: Specifically, the tenant readiness score data after September 8, 2026, may be stale.

Current status: We've identified an upstream process responsible for Copilot Health data was disabled, resulting in the impact. We're focusing on restoring this process to ensure new data is generated while developing a strategy to restore the missing data.

Scope of impact: Some admins attempting to see the latest Copilot Health data in the Microsoft 365 admin center may be impacted.

Root cause: An upstream process responsible for Copilot Health data was disabled, resulting in the impact.

Next update by: Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at 12:00 PM UTC

Title: Some admins may see stale data in the Microsoft 365 Copilot Health page in the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins may have seen stale data in the Copilot Health page in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: Specifically, the tenant readiness score data may not have updated since September 8, 2026.

Final status: The tenant readiness score data stream has been successfully re-enabled and we've confirmed that Copilot Health page is reflecting the updated data as expected to resolve the issue.

Scope of impact: Some admins attempting to see the latest Copilot Health data in the Microsoft 365 admin center may have been impacted.

Start time: Tuesday, September 8, 2026, at 4:05 PM UTC

End time: Friday, October 2, 2026, at 4:21 PM UTC

Root cause: A service process that facilitates data population to the Copilot Health was disabled during a recent change, resulting in the impact.

Next steps: 
- We're reviewing our service change procedures to better understand why the service process disablement wasn't identified prior to deployment to prevent similar issues from happening in the future.

This is the final update for this event.
